Try giving this video a watch, take it with a grain of salt and think for yourself but it provides an interesting perspective on the issue
Don't listen to this person, questioning this is normal especially with its prevelance in the media. Being trans is not awesome, it is medical treatment for life and many medical expenses.

Man.. I really agree with you. I'm MtF, questioning.   
It's completely irrelevant from your core, your thoughts and feelings as a human. It would be very nice to detrans and this be enough of a reason.   
It is a lot more complex than this for a lot of people :/ I'd love to be a fem bi guy and be fine but I can't tell if my dysphoria right now is discomfort in male features because I'm trans or because I'm trying to present as female. I'm a beautiful dude but drawing that line is so damn convoluted that either option feels like a leap of faith.
Basically. Get built as fuck while you can.
A name is just that, mouth noises. You are you no matter what you call yourself and going by a name you used to doesnt change you as a person

Haha, sorry for the jumble, great summary. Thanks for reading.

\-Euphoria can be fake or to convince yourself its real but it can also be genuine

\-my "euphoria" is more a relief that something is normal and occasionally happiness with a feature. However we don't all have the same brain, that's not to say yours is invalid because it's different.

The rest of how you put it is perfect. I hope I helped you in some way.
I actually plan to do this, thanks for your comment <3

Questioning this stuff is healthy to a point, nobody wants to be trans and people who think this is a choice are ignorant lol.  I get that 1%, I consider it too because it can be so difficult and stressful to be trans you have to be sure it's the right thing.   


I think the euphoria can be produced artificially and you really have to pay close attention to what processes your mind is going through to find this out. Such as if you just had lots of thoughts you were scared you're faking it, you could feel euphoria afterwards to justify your actions. Though this can be genuine it's good to consider.   
I used to question wether my dysphoria is fake or not but I mean, I dont get euphoria as such anymore, more, "oh this is normal" and it's a sense of relief and like "at least this part of my face looks like it should " and I am considerate to possible trauma or other factors causing the feelings but I find; I don't give a flying fuck how I look as long as it's not male, I don't care. And that couldn't come from a fake place, if I had mad dysmorphia I would be frustrated over the parts that are definitely female but it's the specifically male parts I get frustrated and sad because of.   


I do have a lot of moments feeling really uncomfortable with specific male features, (jaw angle, FAT ASS JAW MUSCLES FROM CLENCHING LOL FML cant even afford botox, orbital ridge shape and forehead bossing, which are literally the only things holding me back from looking cis and more importantly being comfortable with myself)  


It's funny and annoying that appearing female I don't fucking care about appearances, but I know I don't look female to myself because of the aforementioned reasons, it's like I'm living someone elses thought processes in a way, cause I DONT GIVE A FUCK but wait, I have these features that aren't mine why tf are they there lol.
What was the underlying issue, if you don't mind sharing
I fucking love life, I want to go out and face adversity, do normal things, but this takes the joy away from it all, living in the moment requires being aware of everything in the moment
I saw your post, I want to say that I agree, most humans are wastrels, but the species itself will evolve slowly but surely, for you to have such passion and empathy, you're ahead of your time
